test_policy.notes: Test-optional extended through fall 2028 entry (covers fall 2027), including international applicants. Pitt takes the highest ACT composite and highest SAT superscore; SAT Essay / ACT Writing not required.

requirements.notes: Common App or the Pitt Application are equally acceptable. International applicants must submit a personal statement or the Common App essay. No admissions interviews, but international applicants may submit an InitialView interview. Fee of $55 is from the first-year page; the international page does not state a separate amount. Rolling admission; Frederick Honors College and Guaranteed Admission Programs have their own earlier dates.

deadlines.label: Fall term, international first-year (complete application)
deadlines.notes: Rolling admission; apply early (application opens Aug 1; decisions about 6-8 weeks after the checklist is complete). The page says the Fall 2027 application is open; the year is implied, not printed next to the date.

deadlines.label: International first-year merit scholarship review
deadlines.notes: Completed application by Feb 1 is automatically reviewed for international merit scholarships. The general first-year page cites Dec 1 for automatic academic scholarship consideration.

english_policy.waiver_notes: International students are typically required to submit TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo; waivers are case by case and not automatic (requires contacting Pitt). Waiver profile listed: TOEFL 100+ (subscores 20+; new scale 5.0+ with subscores 4.0+), IELTS 7.0+ (subscores 6.0+), Duolingo 125+, or attended a US high school four years / exempt-country schooling. Only a single-sitting TOEFL iBT is accepted (no MyBest, no Essentials).

english.notes: No hard minimum published. 90-99 with a solid record gets strong consideration for the Pittsburgh campus; 80-89 most often considered for a regional campus (Bradford, Greensburg, Johnstown).
Page equates 90-99 with 4.5 on the new scale; no hard minimum published.
No Pittsburgh-campus minimum published. IELTS 6.5 is listed alongside TOEFL 80-89 (regional-campus range). IELTS Indicator accepted.
No Pittsburgh-campus minimum published. 115-120 is listed alongside TOEFL 80-89 (regional-campus range).

aid.notes: Financial aid is not available to international students. International first-year fall applicants with a complete application by Feb 1 are automatically reviewed for scholarships of up to $10,000 per year (generally eight full-time terms). Proof of financial support required upon admission.

ielts.note: No numeric code; send results from the IELTS portal by searching 'University of Pittsburgh'.

duolingo.note: No numeric code; send results from the Duolingo portal by searching 'University of Pittsburgh'.

tier_notes.nursing: School of Nursing is a top-15 nursing program.
tier_notes.humanities: Philosophy and history & philosophy of science are among the best in the US.
